Inspect the repository and follow AGENTS.md and every relevant file in specs/.

Change at most three files total, counting every modified, added, or deleted file, including tests and supporting modules. Choose one high impact refactor that fits this limit; do not split several oversized files into new modules during one session. Prioritize files over 120 lines, then other project-rule violations, high complexity or weak separation of concerns, and duplicated or poorly structured code. Preserve behavior and avoid unrelated or cosmetic-only edits. Dependencies are installed before this prompt runs. During implementation, run focused checks for changed files: lint changed TypeScript files, run directly related unit tests, and run the relevant package typecheck when changing production TypeScript. Fix failures and rerun affected checks before finishing. Do not run the full `pnpm check`; the workflow runs it as an independent final gate. Do not install dependencies or claim checks passed unless you actually ran them. Review the final diff for stale variables or imports and obvious lint or type errors. If no safe refactor fits the three-file total, leave the repository unchanged. Do not commit or push.
